description: Every pinned version in this configuration lives in one of two places: the pre-commit hooks and the actions of the CI workflow. The Mason packages it adds are pinned and bumped in dynamotn/mason-registry; those of `lua/tools/mason-registry/` come from dytoy and pin nothing.
The workflow runs the StyLua version it reads off the pre-commit hook, so that one bump covers both.
Plugin versions are deliberately left out. `lazy-lock.json` is lazy.nvim's own lockfile and is rewritten by `:Lazy update`, so a bot editing it would only fight the plugin manager.
